name: Imouto ni Boukyaku no Shitone o ~Kenbou Ryoujoku~
original_name: 少女玩具に忘却の褥を～健忘陵辱～
source:
Assault on a younger sister suffering from the amnesia and her counselor!

Her immature undeveloped body gets thoroughly developed into the full woman.

A submissive sister heroine Hikari and her counselor, Aoi, who keeps an eye on Hikari

However, Aoi cannot go against the main character, for a very good reason.

Aoi must face the main character who assaults Hikari. She is troubled because of this dilemma. As a compromising solution, she decides to surrender her body to the main character.

translation:
强暴失忆的妹妹与她的心理咨询师！

妹妹尚未成熟的稚嫩身体，将被彻底开发成完整的女人。

顺从的妹妹天宫光，以及时刻照看她的咨询师杉村葵。
